environment: Headless local WebSocket fixture. The Gateway retries a transient initial attach failure; after a prompt.submit is admitted and the transport is forcibly dropped before its response, it reconnects to the same profile/instance and sends profile/session/replay_epoch-scoped session.events.since from last_seen=2. It replays the missed tool.start exactly once, rejects a wrong-session row, delivers the next live tool.complete event, and never resends prompt.submit. Backoff regressions cover 300ms exponential ceilings, 15s cap, full-jitter bounds, the 5s stable-open reset, terminal HTTP 401/403 classification, and shutdown cancellation. Full locked suite passes 617 library + 15 protocol + 3 launcher tests; all-target check, rustfmt, diff check and 19 task-continuity tests pass.
notes: Partial headless evidence. Transport retry, bounded full-jitter backoff, stable-open reset, owner check and event replay are exercised in local fixtures. Auxiliary HTTP/profile workers remain anchored to the first successful endpoint; a reconnect that changes the endpoint needs a fresh worker binding. Authenticated live Gateway behavior, packaged Windows behavior and formal pinned-source acceptance remain open.
